source_inspections.title: On the size of the class of bivariate extreme-value copulas with a fixed value of Spearman's rho or Kendall's tau

value.rationale: A natural model-calibration problem asks how large Kendall concordance can be at an observed Spearman value. Sharp fixed-rho limits, exact extremizers and a nonattainment regime deliver structural information for an established infinite-dimensional copula family; the strict gap from known xi>=0 is nontrivial and the negative regime requires a moment-preserving singular limit.
